$comment: Application registry. The launcher resolves a menu tile's 'code' to an entry here, so
Menu Path's hardcoded http://localhost:876x/ URLs become internal routes on one origin.
ready    - converted to React and exercised end to end
scaffold - route exists and renders, conversion from the legacy HTML not finished
planned  - no application behind it yet (the launcher says so rather than failing silently)
'services' lists the config/services.json keys the app is permitted to call. The gateway
does not enforce this yet; it documents intent and drives the launcher's service badges.
'legacy' points at the HTML file the React app was converted from.

apps.title: Origination Ticket (OTTK)
apps.note: Converted from legacy/OTTK.html with its original stylesheet scoped under .ottk. Not yet run against live SAP.

apps.title: Distribution Ticket (DTTK)
apps.note: Converted from legacy/DTTK.html with its original stylesheet scoped under .dttk. Also serves the read-only entry points OTTK and Deal ID link to (?display=<dttk> and ?displayOttk=<ottk>). Not yet run against live SAP.

apps.title: Deal ID Creation
apps.note: Converted and exercised end to end against a stub backend: load, filter, select, balance derivation, the balance guard, create, key recovery and refresh. Not yet run against live SAP.

apps.title: Trade Flow Upload
apps.note: Converted from legacy/Uplaod TF.html with its original stylesheet scoped under .tfupload. Parses .xlsx in the browser with no third-party library, as the original did. Not yet run against live SAP.
